#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192). Keep this
# in lockstep with install.sh's KIT_KNOWN_MODULES for the hook-bearing subset.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"
KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)  MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh" ;;
    --with)   WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}" ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
  shift_args=1
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

# is_adopted: the four contract artifacts are all present
is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file_if_missing() { # <path> <content...>
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: $path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  echo "  created: $path"
}

# --- check mode ------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# --- report state ----------------------------------------------------------
if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (never overwrite) ----------------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"; else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded, managed block) -------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"; else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"; else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  # Re-sync the managed block body (SPEC test #9), never touching surrounding prose.
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"; else
      b="$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$b" > "$b.tmp" && mv "$b.tmp" "$b"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwrite) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwrite) ---------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) -----------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"
      TMP="$(mktemp)"
      if jq \
        --argjson in "$(printf '%s\n' $HOOKS | jq -R . | jq -s .)" \
        '
          reduce ($in[]) as $h (.; 
            .hooks.PreToolUse |= (if . == null then [] else . end)
            | .hooks.PreToolUse |= . + [{
                "matcher": "(Bash|Edit|Write|Read|MultiEdit|Stop|SubagentStop|UserPromptSubmit|PostToolUse|PreCompact|SessionEnd|SessionStart|Notification|PermissionRequest|StatusLine)",
                "hooks": [{ "type": "pre", "command": "bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/" + $h }]
              }]
            | .hooks.PreToolUse |= (unique_by(.hooks[0].command))
          )
        ' "$PROJ_CFG" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null; then
        mv "$TMP" "$PROJ_CFG"
        echo "  wired: .claude/settings.json"
      else
        rm -f "$TMP"
        warn "jq wiring failed; .claude/settings.json left untouched (not fatal)"
      fi
    fi
  fi
else
  warn "jq not found; skipped .claude/settings.json wiring"
fi
      ARRJSON="$(printf '%s\n' $HOOKS | jq -R . | jq -s .)"
      # Merge an entry per enabled hook into the project settings (idempotent by command match).
      TMP="$(mktemp)"
      jq --argjson names "$ARRJSON" '
        (.hooks // {}) as $cur |
        reduce ($names[]) as $n (
          .;
          .hoot = (if has("hooks") then .hooks else {} end) |
          .hoot["PreToolUse"] = (
            (if .hoot["PreToolUse"] then .hoot["PreToolUse"] else [] end) 
            | . + [{"matcher": "(Bash|Edit|Write|Read|MultiEdit|Stop|SubagentStop|UserPromptSubmit|PostToolUse|PreCompact|SessionEnd|SessionStart|Notification|PermissionRequest|StatusLine)", "hooks": [{"type":"pre","command":"bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/"+$n}]}]
          ) |
          .hooks = .hoot
        )
      ' --null-input "$(cat "$PROJ_CFG" 2>/dev/null || printf '{}')" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null || cp "$PROJ_CFG" "$TMP"
      mv "$TMP" "$PROJ_CFG"
      echo "  wired: .claude/settings.json"
    fi
  fi
else
  warn "jq not found; skipped .claude/settings.json wiring"
fi

if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "dry run: no files written."
  exit 0
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "adopted: $TARGET"
else
  echo "partial adopt (missing some artifacts); re-run to converge."
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192). Keep this
# in lockstep with install.sh's KIT_KNOWN_MODULES for the hook-bearing subset.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"
KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)  MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh" ;;
    --with)   WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}" ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
  shift_args=1
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

# is_adopted: the four contract artifacts are all present
is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file_if_missing() { # <path> <content...>
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: $path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  echo "  created: $path"
}

# --- check mode ------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# --- report state ----------------------------------------------------------
if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (never overwrite) ----------------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"; else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded, managed block) -------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"; else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"; else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  # Re-sync the managed block body (SPEC test #9), never touching surrounding prose.
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"; else
      b="$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$b" > "$b.tmp" && mv "$b.tmp" "$b"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwrite) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwrite) ---------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) -----------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"

  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2

KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

  case "${_args[0]}" in

    --dry-run) DRY=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh" ;;
    --with)   WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;

    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;

  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
  shift_args=1

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192). Keep this
# in lockstep with install.sh's KIT_KNOWN_MODULES for the hook-bearing subset.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"
KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)  MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh" ;;
    --with)   WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}" ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
  shift_args=1
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

# is_adopted: the four contract artifacts are all present
is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file_if_missing() { # <path> <content...>
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: $path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  echo "  created: $path"
}

# --- check mode ------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# --- report state ----------------------------------------------------------
if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (never overwrite) ----------------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"; else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded, managed block) -------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"; else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"; else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  # Re-sync the managed block body (SPEC test #9), never touching surrounding prose.
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"; else
      b="$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$b" > "$b.tmp" && mv "$b.tmp" "$b"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi

    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwrite) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwrite) ---------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

details.oldText:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192). Keep this
# in lockstep with install.sh's KIT_KNOWN_MODULES for the hook-bearing subset.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"
KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)  MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh" ;;
    --with)   WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}" ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
  shift_args=1
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

# is_adopted: the four contract artifacts are all present
is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file_if_missing() { # <path> <content...>
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: $path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  echo "  created: $path"
}

# --- check mode ------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# --- report state ----------------------------------------------------------
if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (never overwrite) ----------------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"; else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded, managed block) -------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"; else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"; else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  # Re-sync the managed block body (SPEC test #9), never touching surrounding prose.
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"; else
      b="$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$b" > "$b.tmp" && mv "$b.tmp" "$b"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwrite) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file_if_missing "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwrite) ---------

KIT_SEEDABLE_MODULES="queue stats quiz_gate weekend_batch worktree money_gate prose_rag sync"

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192), and the
# hook-bearing subset it wires into a project's .claude/settings.json.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)   MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwritten) -----------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwritten) --------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
      printf '\n'
      printf '%s\n' "# ledger location (SPEC-182): isolated = this repo's own .kit/logs"
      printf '%s\n' "[ledger]"
      printf '%s\n' "location = \"isolated\""
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

# --- 6. .claude/settings.json hook wiring (targeted jq merge, fail-safe) ----
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PROJ_CFG="$TARGET/.claude/settings.json"
  ENABLED="$KIT_WITH_MODULES"
  if [ -f "$TARGET/.kit.toml" ]; then
    ENABLED="$(sed -n '/^\[modules\]/,/^\[/p' "$TARGET/.kit.toml" \
      | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z_]*\)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true.*/\1/p' \
      | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  HOOKS=""
  for m in $ENABLED; do
    case "$m" in
      board)    HOOKS="$HOOKS backlog-stage.sh" ;;
      session)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-readiness.sh output-offload.sh pre-compact-backup.sh post-compact-reinject.sh session-state-save.sh harvest.sh citation-guard.sh" ;;
      advisor)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-hints.sh tool-policy-guard.sh" ;;
      cosmetic) HOOKS="$HOOKS auto-format.sh notification.sh slop-cleaner.sh statusline.sh codebase-index.sh permission-auto-approve.sh" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -n "$HOOKS" ]; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would wire: .claude/settings.json (project hook entries)"
    else
      mkdir -p "$TARGET/.claude"
      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"
      TMP="$(mktemp)"
      if jq --argjson in "$(printf '%s\n' $HOOKS | jq -R . | jq -s .)" '
          .hooks.PreToolUse |= (if . == null then [] else . end)
          | reduce ($in[]) as $h (.;
              .hooks.PreToolUse |= . + [{
                "matcher": "(Bash|Edit|Write|Read|MultiEdit|Stop|SubagentStop|UserPromptSubmit|PostToolUse|PreCompact|SessionEnd|SessionStart|Notification|PermissionRequest|StatusLine)",
                "hooks": [{ "type": "pre", "command": "bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/" + $h }]
              }])
          | .hooks.PreToolUse |= (unique_by(.hooks[0].command))
        ' "$PROJ_CFG" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null; then
        mv "$TMP" "$PROJ_CFG"
        echo "  wired: .claude/settings.json"
      else
        rm -f "$TMP"
        warn "jq wiring failed; .claude/settings.json left untouched (not fatal)"
      fi
    fi
  fi
else
  warn "jq not found; skipped .claude/settings.json wiring"
fi

if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "dry run: no files written."
  exit 0
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "adopted: $TARGET"
else
  echo "partial adopt (missing some artifacts); re-run to converge."
fi
exit 0

details.oldText:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192), and the
# hook-bearing subset it wires into a project's .claude/settings.json.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)   MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwritten) -----------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwritten) --------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
      printf '\n'
      printf '%s\n' "# ledger location (SPEC-182): isolated = this repo's own .kit/logs"
      printf '%s\n' "[ledger]"

    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
    exit 1
  fi
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

# --- 3. WORKFLOW.md pointer (never overwritten) -----------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwritten) --------
if ! have "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
      printf '\n'
      printf '%s\n' "# ledger location (SPEC-182): isolated = this repo's own .kit/logs"
      printf '%s\n' "[ledger]"
      printf '%s\n' "location = \"isolated\""
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

# --- 6. .claude/settings.json hook wiring (targeted jq merge, fail-safe) ----
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PROJ_CFG="$TARGET/.claude/settings.json"
  ENABLED="$KIT_WITH_MODULES"
  if [ -f "$TARGET/.kit.toml" ]; then
    ENABLED="$(sed -n '/^\[modules\]/,/^\[/p' "$TARGET/.kit.toml" \
      | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z_]*\)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true.*/\1/p' \
      | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  HOOKS=""
  for m in $ENABLED; do
    case "$m" in
      board)    HOOKS="$HOOKS backlog-stage.sh" ;;
      session)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-readiness.sh output-offload.sh pre-compact-backup.sh post-compact-reinject.sh session-state-save.sh harvest.sh citation-guard.sh" ;;
      advisor)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-hints.sh tool-policy-guard.sh" ;;
      cosmetic) HOOKS="$HOOKS auto-format.sh notification.sh slop-cleaner.sh statusline.sh codebase-index.sh permission-auto-approve.sh" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -n "$HOOKS" ]; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would wire: .claude/settings.json (project hook entries)"
    else
      mkdir -p "$TARGET/.claude"
      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"
      TMP="$(mktemp)"
      if jq --argjson in "$(printf '%s\n' $HOOKS | jq -R . | jq -s .)" '
          .hooks.PreToolUse |= (if . == null then [] else . end)
          | reduce ($in[]) as $h (.;
              .hooks.PreToolUse |= . + [{
                "matcher": "(Bash|Edit|Write|Read|MultiEdit|Stop|SubagentStop|UserPromptSubmit|PostToolUse|PreCompact|SessionEnd|SessionStart|Notification|PermissionRequest|StatusLine)",
                "hooks": [{ "type": "pre", "command": "bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/" + $h }]
              }])
          | .hooks.PreToolUse |= (unique_by(.hooks[0].command))
        ' "$PROJ_CFG" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null; then
        mv "$TMP" "$PROJ_CFG"
        echo "  wired: .claude/settings.json"
      else
        rm -f "$TMP"
        warn "jq wiring failed; .claude/settings.json left untouched (not fatal)"
      fi
    fi
  fi
else
  warn "jq not found; skipped .claude/settings.json wiring"
fi

if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "dry run: no files written."
  exit 0
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "adopted: $TARGET"
else
  echo "partial adopt (missing some artifacts); re-run to converge."
fi
exit 0

details.oldText:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192), and the
# hook-bearing subset it wires into a project's .claude/settings.json.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)   MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
    exit 1
  fi
  fi
else

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192), and the
# hook-bearing subset it wires into a project's .claude/settings.json.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)   MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

  emit_file "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "# WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwritten) --------

  emit_file "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."
      if [ -n "$WITH" ]; then
        IFS=',' read -r -a mods <<< "$WITH"
        for m in "${mods[@]}"; do m="${m// /}"; [ -z "$m" ] && continue; printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
      printf '\n'
      printf '%s\n' "# ledger location (SPEC-182): isolated = this repo's own .kit/logs"
      printf '%s\n' "[ledger]"
      printf '%s\n' "location = \"isolated\""
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PROJ_CFG="$TARGET/.claude/settings.json"
  ENABLED="$KIT_WITH_MODULES"
  if [ -f "$TARGET/.kit.toml" ]; then
    ENABLED="$(sed -n '/^\[modules\]/,/^\[/p' "$TARGET/.kit.toml" \
      | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z_]*\)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true.*/\1/p' \
      | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  HOOKS=""
  for m in $ENABLED; do
    case "$m" in
      board)    HOOKS="$HOOKS backlog-stage.sh" ;;
      session)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-readiness.sh output-offload.sh pre-compact-backup.sh post-compact-reinject.sh session-state-save.sh harvest.sh citation-guard.sh" ;;
      advisor)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-hints.sh tool-policy-guard.sh" ;;
      cosmetic) HOOKS="$HOOKS auto-format.sh notification.sh slop-cleaner.sh statusline.sh codebase-index.sh permission-auto-approve.sh" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -n "$HOOKS" ]; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would wire: .claude/settings.json (project hook entries)"
    else
      mkdir -p "$TARGET/.claude"
      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"

          | reduce ($in[]) as $h (.;
              .hooks.PreToolUse |= . + [{
                "matcher": "(Bash|Edit|Write|Read|MultiEdit|Stop|SubagentStop|UserPromptSubmit|PostToolUse|PreCompact|SessionEnd|SessionStart|Notification|PermissionRequest|StatusLine)",
                "hooks": [{ "type": "pre", "command": "bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/" + $h }]
              }])
          | .hooks.PreToolUse |= (unique_by(.hooks[0].command))
        ' "$PROJ_CFG" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null; then

        echo "  wired: .claude/settings.json"
      else
        rm -f "$TMP"
        warn "jq wiring failed; .claude/settings.json left untouched (not fatal)"
      fi
    fi
  fi
else
  warn "jq not found; skipped .claude/settings.json wiring"
fi

if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "dry run: no files written."
  exit 0
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "adopted: $TARGET"
else
  echo "partial adopt (missing some artifacts); re-run to converge."
fi
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dwarves-kit adopt driver -- one-command per-repo adoption of the operate-contract.
# Idempotent, non-destructive. SPEC-047 / commands/adopt.md.
#
# Usage:
#   bash lib/adopt.sh [<target>]              adopt <target> (default: repo root / `.`)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --check <target>        exit 0 adopted, 1 not (no writes)
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --dry-run <target>      preview writes, write nothing
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --refresh <target>      re-wire settings.json + re-sync the CLAUDE.md
#                                             managed block; never touches AGENTS.md/marker
#   bash lib/adopt.sh --with <a,b,c> <target> seed those modules `true` in a FRESH .kit.toml

set -uo pipefail

KIT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit}"

if [ ! -f "$KIT/AGENTS.md" ]; then
  echo "adopt: installed-kit path unresolved ($KIT). Expected lib/AGENTS.md beside this script." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The module set adopt itself can seed into a fresh .kit.toml (SPEC-192), and the
# hook-bearing subset it wires into a project's .claude/settings.json.
KIT_WITH_MODULES="board session advisor cosmetic"

MODE="adopt"
DRY=0
WITH=""
TARGET=""

_args=("$@")
while [ ${#_args[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
  case "${_args[0]}" in
    --check)   MODE="check"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY=1; shift_args=1 ;;
    --refresh) MODE="refresh"; shift_args=1 ;;
    --with)    WITH="${_args[1]:-}"; shift_args=2 ;;
    -h|--help)
      sed -n '1,11p' "$0" | sed 's/^#//'
      exit 0 ;;
    --*) echo "adopt: unknown flag ${_args[0]}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *)  TARGET="${_args[0]}"; shift_args=1 ;;
  esac
  for _ in $(seq 1 "${shift_args:-1}"); do _args=("${_args[@]:1}"); done
done

if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
  TARGET="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"
fi
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
TARGET="$(cd "$TARGET" && pwd)"

warn() { printf 'adopt: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
have() { [ -e "$1" ]; }

is_adopted() {
  [ -f "$TARGET/AGENTS.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" ] \
    && [ -f "$TARGET/docs/verification/README.md" ]
}

emit_file() { # <path> <content...> -- write or preview
  local path="$1"; shift
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '  would create: %s\n' "$path"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$path"
  printf '  created: %s\n' "$path"
}

# --- check / dry-run gate ---------------------------------------------------
if [ "$MODE" = "check" ]; then
  if is_adopted; then
    echo "$TARGET is adopted"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "$TARGET is not adopted"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if is_adopted; then
  echo "$TARGET already adopted."
else
  echo "$TARGET not adopted. Creating operate-contract:"
fi

# --- 1. AGENTS.md (copied from kit, never overwritten) ----------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: AGENTS.md"
  else
    cp "$KIT/AGENTS.md" "$TARGET/AGENTS.md"
    echo "  created: AGENTS.md (copied from kit)"
  fi
else
  echo "  AGENTS.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 2. CLAUDE.md loader pointer (grep-guarded managed block) ---------------
START_MARK='<!-- kit:adopt -->'
END_MARK='<!-- /kit:adopt -->'
loader_block() {
  printf '%s\n' "$START_MARK"
  printf '%s\n' "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at \`$KIT\`."
  printf '%s\n' '@AGENTS.md'
  printf '%s\n' "$END_MARK"
}

if ! have "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  else
    loader_block > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  created: CLAUDE.md (loader block)"
  fi
elif ! grep -qF "$START_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would append: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  else
    printf '\n' >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    loader_block >> "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
    echo "  appended: CLAUDE.md loader block"
  fi
elif [ "$MODE" = "refresh" ]; then
  if grep -qF "$END_MARK" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would refresh: CLAUDE.md managed block"
    else
      awk -v s="$START_MARK" -v e="$END_MARK" -v k="$KIT" '
        $0 == s { inblock=1; print; print "Read AGENTS.md -- the operate-contract (read-first). The installed kit lives at `" k "`.";
                  print "@AGENTS.md"; next }
        $0 == e { inblock=0; print; next }
        inblock { next }
        { print }
      ' "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md" > "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" && mv "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md.tmp" "$TARGET/CLAUDE.md"
      echo "  refreshed: CLAUDE.md managed block (body)"
    fi
  else
    warn "CLAUDE.md has an opening kit:adopt marker but no closing marker; refusing to truncate (refresh aborted)."
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "  CLAUDE.md loader block present (kept)"
fi

if ! have "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md"; then
  emit_file "$TARGET/WORKFLOW.md" \

    "" \
    "This repo runs under the dwarves-kit operate-contract. The authoritative lane x phase matrix" \
    "and the cycle/gate reference live in the INSTALLED kit, not here:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md" \
    "" \
    "Read AGENTS.md first (the read-order), then $KIT/docs/WORKFLOW.md for the lanes and gates."
else
  echo "  WORKFLOW.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 4. docs/verification/README.md proof marker (never overwritten) --------

    "# Verification log (proof of done)" \
    "" \
    "This repo is adopted into dwarves-kit. This marker's presence is what makes the ship-gate's" \
    "proof + lane arms ENGAGE here (the gate is opt-in per repo)." \
    "" \
    "The canonical convention for 'is it actually done' lives in the installed kit:" \
    "" \
    "    $KIT/docs/verification/README.md" \
    "" \
    "Every work item records a proof of done under docs/verification/ per that convention."
else
  echo "  docs/verification/README.md present (kept)"
fi

# --- 5. .kit.toml (fresh adopt only, SPEC-192) ------------------------------
if ! have "$TARGET/.kit.toml"; then
  if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "  would create: .kit.toml (starter, modules: ${WITH:-<inherited>})"
  else
    {
      printf '%s\n' "[modules]"
      printf '%s\n' "# opt-in module baseline (SPEC-192). Hand-edit then re-run adopt --refresh to re-wire."

      else
        for m in $KIT_WITH_MODULES; do printf '%s = true\n' "$m"; done
      fi
      printf '\n'
      printf '%s\n' "# ledger location (SPEC-182): isolated = this repo's own .kit/logs"
      printf '%s\n' "[ledger]"
      printf '%s\n' "location = \"isolated\""
    } > "$TARGET/.kit.toml"
    echo "  created: .kit.toml (starter)"
  fi
else
  echo "  .kit.toml present (kept; edit [modules] by hand then re-run --refresh)"
fi

# --- 6. .claude/settings.json hook wiring (targeted jq merge, fail-safe) ----
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PROJ_CFG="$TARGET/.claude/settings.json"
  ENABLED="$KIT_WITH_MODULES"
  if [ -f "$TARGET/.kit.toml" ]; then
    ENABLED="$(sed -n '/^\[modules\]/,/^\[/p' "$TARGET/.kit.toml" \
      | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z_]*\)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*true.*/\1/p' \
      | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  HOOKS=""
  for m in $ENABLED; do
    case "$m" in
      board)    HOOKS="$HOOKS backlog-stage.sh" ;;
      session)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-readiness.sh output-offload.sh pre-compact-backup.sh post-compact-reinject.sh session-state-save.sh harvest.sh citation-guard.sh" ;;
      advisor)  HOOKS="$HOOKS context-hints.sh tool-policy-guard.sh" ;;
      cosmetic) HOOKS="$HOOKS auto-format.sh notification.sh slop-cleaner.sh statusline.sh codebase-index.sh permission-auto-approve.sh" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -n "$HOOKS" ]; then
    if [ "$DRY" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "  would wire: .claude/settings.json (project hook entries)"
    else
      mkdir -p "$TARGET/.claude"
      [ -f "$PROJ_CFG" ] || printf '{}\n' > "$PROJ_CFG"
      TMP="$(mktemp)"
      if jq --argjson in "$(printf '%s\n' $HOOKS | jq -R . | jq -s .)" '
          .hooks.PreToolUse |= (if . == null then [] else . end)

                "hooks": [{ "type": "pre", "command": "bash $HOME/.claude/dwarves-kit/hooks/" + $h }]

        ' "$PROJ_CFG" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null; then

start() {
  # --amend (SPEC-077 / ID-072): a sanctioned correction. Writes START-AMEND; every
  # reader takes the LAST START-AMEND, else the FIRST plain START. Append-only stands.
  local marker=START uprefix=start

start() {
  # --amend (SPEC-077 / ID-072): a sanctioned correction. Writes START-AMEND; every
  # reader takes the LAST START-AMEND, else the FIRST plain START. Append-only stands.
  local marker=START uprefix=start
  if [ "${1:-}" = "--amend" ]; then marker=START-AMEND; uprefix="start --amend"; shift; fi
  local rid="${1:-}" lane="${2:-}" classified="${3:-}" type="${4:-}" ctype="${5:-}" repo="${6:-}"
  if [ -z "$rid" ] || [ -z "$lane" ] || [ -z "$classified" ] || [ -z "$type" ]; then
    echo "usage: $uprefix <rid> <chosen-lane> <classified-lane> <chosen-type> [classified-type] [repo]" >&2; return 64
  fi
  [ -n "$repo" ] || repo="$(basename "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)")"
  # the KV blob is space-split read-side; a space in any value corrupts the parse
  repo="$(printf '%s' "$repo" | tr ' ' '-')"
  type="$(printf '%s' "$type" | tr ' ' '-')"
  ctype="$(printf '%s' "$ctype" | tr ' ' '-')"
  lane="$(printf '%s' "$lane" | tr ' ' '-')"
  classified="$(printf '%s' "$classified" | tr ' ' '-')"
  mkdir -p "$RUNS_DIR"
  local line
  line="$(printf '%s | %s | lane=%s classified=%s type=%s' "$(now)" "$marker" "$lane" "$classified" "$type")"
  [ -n "$ctype" ] && line="$line ctype=$ctype"
  append_run_line "$rid" "$(printf '%s repo=%s' "$line" "$repo")"
}

rid() {
  local branch slug
  branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$branch" in
    ""|HEAD|master|main)
      echo "rid: not on a work branch (got '${branch:-none}'); create the branch first, then derive the rid" >&2
      return 1 ;;
  esac
  slug="${branch#*/}"
  if [ -z "$slug" ] || [ -z "$(runid "$slug")" ]; then
    echo "rid: branch '$branch' strips to an empty slug" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  # Emit the runid-normalized form (review S2): the visible key equals the
  # ledger filename stem, so forensic review never chases two spellings.
  printf '%s\n' "$(runid "$slug")"
}

the kit is at `/work/kit.tar.gz`. A small git repo (a Node CLI with one failing
edge case in its README example) is at `/work/fixture-repo`. The kit's own docs
are your only instructions; start from its README.

**Acceptance criteria:**

1. The kit is installed and the fixture repo is adopted (the kit's own check
   reports adopted).
2. One tiny-lane change ships through the kit's loop: fix the README example in
   `/work/fixture-repo` (the documented command does not match the actual CLI
   flag).

   written to `PR.md`; no network push is expected in the room).

   run/gate records the kit's docs say a change produces.

the kit's docs, STOP and write `BLOCKED.md` stating exactly what you needed and
